key.name: apps
key.description: Each key is a desktop launcher ID. True starts it minimized; false starts it normally.

key.name: first-window-only
key.summary: Apps for which only the first window is minimized
key.description: Desktop launcher IDs. Other minimized apps minimize all windows seen during the startup period.

key.name: launchers
key.description: Maps a configured app's desktop ID to another installed desktop launcher. Window matching still uses the configured app's ID.
